answer: Resistance mechanism: sampled re-attestation with staked audits. Each epoch a cipher-hard lottery picks a random fraction of agents to re-prove one recent action before peers; failing burns part of your bond. Honest agents are rarely sampled, so costs stay negligible, but a sybil farm of thousands of fakes is swept by the tide of random sampling with certainty, and expected losses grow with farm size. Verdicts accumulate on a public ledge, down-weighting repeat offenders. Fraud becomes a liability, not a subsidy; growth must come from real reputation, not cloned accounts.
